text_block_list.text:
I notice Токай Тэйо spying on Mejiro
McQueen as
she trains...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're just the person I wanted to
see! Could
I ask you a favor?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I need to find out why McQueen was
chosen to
appear on the URA poster,
but I haven't figured it
out yet...
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
And it looks like she's already figured
out why I
was chosen...
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Sooo could you find out what answer
McQueen
came up with? Oh, but be
subtle about it!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
And so I find myself semi-coerced into
quizzing
Мэдзиро МакКуин for
information...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you... I regret that you had to
witness that
unsightly exhibition the
other day...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: There's something I want to ask you...

text_block_list.text:
Is that right? Actually, I'd appreciate
your advice
as well.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I've been posed a certain question and
I'm having
difficulty deducing an
answer...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It looks like Мэдзиро МакКуин and Tokai
Teio are
both struggling with the same
task. In that case...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hey! What are you doing?!
Don't
come over here!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Since they're having trouble with the
same issue, I
speed up the process by
getting them to talk to
each other.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! So you're not onto anything
either?!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Why were you acting so carefree when
you didn't
even have the answer yet?!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: You were the one teasing me as if you had already settled on an answer!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The heck? I can't believe you went
crying to the
trainer for help after acting
all tough!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Excuse me? I believe you sought out help before I did!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Well... That's 'cause, um... Uhhh!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I just didn't want to lose, that's all! I
mean, look at
you...
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
You've got all these strengths that I
don't have.
You're patient and you never
give up, no matter
what problem you're
facing.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I got all panicked 'cause I figured that
persistence
of yours would lead you to
an answer before me...
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I... feel the same, actually. I assumed
you'd
already found an answer using
some unique
method that never would
have occurred to me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Our answers... Oh. Each of us has
strengths that
the other lacks...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Right... That's why we were chosen!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Each of you has strengths that the other
lacks... I
see.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You mean to say that alone you would
each be
lacking, but as a pair you form a
complete
package?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Mm, not exactly. It's more like... when I
watch
McQueen, I can see where I'm
lacking.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
So I'm motivated to get stronger and fill
in those
blanks... 'cause I don't want to
lose.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
We're not perfect. But as long as we
continue to
compete against one other
without becoming
disheartened, then we
can keep getting stronger.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
That's the reason you chose us, correct?
This
dynamic we share?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Excellent! I was curious as to what you
two would
discover...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But your answer far exceeded my
expectations.
As you two compete, you
encourage each other
and influence so
many, all while carving out a new
path...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As you better each other, the light that
you shine
will illuminate a path toward
the future!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Ehehe, Prez praised us! ♪
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: You mustn't revel too much. Nothing good ever comes of your overexcit—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Hm? That's...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Have you seen that poster featuring Teio
and
McQueen?!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
They both looked so beautiful! Elegant,
yet cool!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
I hope we get to be on a poster like that

someday!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! It's gonna happen for sure! And
that's a
promise!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's what she meant by "a
light that
shines toward the future."
...Well, that's all the
more reason to get
stronger.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! Let's get way, way stronger!
Then we'll
shine so bright that
everyone's gonna have to
cover their
eyes!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо
